title: The release driver runs pending plan groups
when: Item QA dispatch finds attached post-deploy plans whose plan groups are still open. No item holder is woken for them.
need: The release driver executes every automatic pending plan group and run-scoped QA plan. Independent groups continue while another awaits agent review. Review and manual-evidence waits reach the live driver, then the starting session, then steering. A group failure names its report and items. Plan commands use the candidate checkout and detached HEAD, never DEPLOYMENT_MEMBER_REF; post-deploy command-ci cases refuse at authoring or attach.
surface: Run-scoped plan-group notice; plan run result and help
review: Source coverage; live delivery remains unverified until release.
